title: The Rings
summary: The Vigilant fires; Jonah, feverish with the settling and with plate leaking from his hands, takes the Kestrel into the broken legion transport and lets the genius see through his eyes to find the way. Nine hours hidden. Marchand confronts him: 'What are you?' Jonah devours Varro's lorica in the hold and receives Varro's footwork and Varro's contempt. They fake a debris strike, drop Varro's body into the rings, and dock at Anvil. Jonah holds the genius still through a dock reading and passes. He steps back from Mara's embrace. Marchand: 'I didn't see anything. Captain.'
story_date: 388, three weeks before Founding Day, next day

events.description: The Kestrel escapes the Vigilant into the broken legion transport in the rings; aft cargo ring damaged by a round.
Jonah lets the genius look through his eyes: the transport's interior becomes a single known shape (first Sense use). Plate leaks from his hands during settling.
Jonah devours Varro's lorica in the hold. First spolia. Grade about 8. Varro's echo: a duellist's footwork and contempt for Collars. The fever evens out; he can feel where plate will come out.
Varro's body put out the airlock into the rings inside the transport.
Bram fakes a debris strike on the hull. The Kestrel docks at Anvil. Marchand reports: debris strike, captain lost, no boarding, no salvage.
Jonah holds the genius still (Hush turned inward, by instinct) through the dock reading and passes as a peregrine.
Tom and Mara at the dock gate. Jonah steps back from Mara's embrace. Marchand: 'I didn't see anything. Captain.'

knowledge_changes.fact: Jonah carries a whole, unregistered genius (Tacitus) that does not obey imperium and has no fuse.
Jonah killed Decurion Varro on the derelict and devoured his lorica.
Jonah's collar is a dead shell; Lock will not work on him and any Stripe who says the word will see it.
The genius can be held still through a reading, like holding a breath.
Devouring a lorica leaves the bearer's habits in Jonah: Varro's footwork and Varro's contempt for Collars.

thread_beats.description: The genius looks out through his eyes in the transport; devours Varro; settles. Grade 8. Hush by instinct at the dock.
Nine hours of hunger in the dark; his hand goes down on the stripe before the deciding is done. Hunger returns faintly by the end.
Varro's echo: the footwork Jonah watched at fourteen, now in his legs, with the contempt folded under it.
Marchand watched from the hatch twice, wrote the false manifest, and calls Jonah 'Captain' in a way that is not a promise.
Jonah steps back from Mara's embrace at the dock gate. She goes careful.
The empty stone box in his kit, the sealed packet inside his suit. Morrow suspects and does not ask.

clues.description: Marchand's hands are very steady, which is how Jonah knows he is frightened. The letter is fear before envy.
clues.mechanism: 03_characters: Marchand's secret. Pays in ch.4 interlude.

clues.description: Varro's stripe after devouring: skin with a shape like a stripe rubbed off with a thumb.
clues.mechanism: What an unstripped forearm looks like; the Censor's scar (ch.12) and Jonah's faked one (ch.8).

clues.description: The genius went still when Varro said the word to the collar 'because it was listening'; Jonah can hold it still like a breath.
clues.mechanism: Hush turned inward, the trick Yara recognizes in ch.33 and that saves him in ch.25.

clues.description: Morrow's hand on Ochoa's blanket; he nods at Jonah like a man nodding at a hull that came apart faster than the numbers said. He does not ask.
clues.mechanism: Morrow knows more than the manifest. Ch.37 he is the one who kept faith; ch.3 he says the petition goes ahead.

clues.description: Jonah does not say anything over Varro's body; the thing he has to say is what the crowd says when a Stripe wins a bout, and he does not say that either.
clues.mechanism: Plants the crowd's Latin prayer to Mars that Jonah will say in ch.3.

character_emotional_states.emotional_state: Feverish, settled at grade 8, carrying a dead man's feet and contempt, afraid to touch Mara.
Careful. Something is wrong and she saw it.
Grieving Ochoa; suspects; will not stop the petition.

new_objects.significance: Evidence of the derelict. Marchand saw it.

new_objects.name: The false manifest
new_objects.description: Marchand's report: debris strike, captain lost, no boarding, no salvage.
new_objects.significance: Marchand's leverage over Jonah and the crew.

scenes.summary: Escape under fire into the legion transport; the genius sees the way.
Nine hours hidden. 'What are you?' The plan for the story.
Devouring Varro's lorica; the echo. Marchand at the hatch again.
Dock reading passed; Morrow; Mara; 'I didn't see anything. Captain.'

notes: Jonah grade 8 unsettled. Ochoa's body to the melt (Collar). Legal captaincy: Marchand is citizen of record; Ochoa captained by Morrow's dispensation. Varro's body in the rings, stripe rubbed off.
